item.description:
### What's changed - Improved playback progress reporting and refined Apple audio behavior. - Improved Apple sign-in and standardized app identifiers. - Refined autoplay, queue handling, and playback history. - Updated project artwork and README presentation. - Added signed macOS updates from BitChord releases, with preferences for automatic checks and background installation. iPhone and iPad now alert when an update is available and link to its release notes. - Fixed the macOS framework search path so the app and Sparkle updater launch correctly.
### macOS build Apple Silicon (arm64). This replaces the earlier 0.1.1 DMG with the Sparkle-enabled build. Existing 0.1.1 installs need to install this build once before future Mac updates can be installed through Sparkle. The app is ad-hoc signed with no Apple Development identity or provisioning profiles. The DMG is unsigned and this build is not notarized, so macOS may block the first launch.
### Opening BitChord on macOS Only continue if you downloaded this DMG from the official BitChord release and trust it.
**System Settings:** Move BitChord to Applications and try to open it once. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to Security, choose **Open Anyway** for BitChord, then confirm **Open** in the warning dialog.
**Terminal:** After moving BitChord to Applications, open Terminal and run: ```sh xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/BitChord.app" open "/Applications/BitChord.app" ``` This removes the downloaded-file quarantine attribute from the app bundle so Gatekeeper no longer blocks this launch.
